name: LIVING HELL
detailed_description:
LIVING HELL is an online co-op horror game for 1-4 players. In a city destroyed by solar radiation, scavenge whatever you can to survive another day, but beware: the heat isn't your only enemy.

WORLD IN DECAY

The collapse of the ozone layer was catastrophic. Temperatures soared and the exposure killed millions. Governments did what they could with medical aid, curfews and military deployment. But society broke down rapidly, and the solar radiation triggered widespread, horrifying mutations.

SURVIVE THE HEAT

You play as a group of survivors sheltering in Pelican City’s underground subway system. The heat is truly suffocating and managing your Thermal Load is essential for survival. Venture into the city at night to scavenge for supplies to keep cool. As sunrise nears, the heat builds and the city fills with mutant creatures.

DELIVER THE DATA

You will have access to the government mutation research AI, DAWN-4o. While out in the city, come face to face with the terrifying unknown as you search for mutation specimens. Delivering these to DAWN allows her to develop ways of keeping you alive.

WHO'S GOT YOUR BACK?

Communicate using proximity voice chat and walkie-talkies.
Craft, carry, and manage supplies as a team.
Be careful who you trust - heat does strange things to people.
